clarifications.isorophus: Five strongly curved star-like grooves means asymmetric four contrasolar/one solar articulated surface ambulacra, not five equal spirals or open starfish arms.
clarifications.eleutherocrinus: Stemless whole living reconstruction,4long and1short broadened ambulacrum. D ray label follows Fay1961 and Bohaty2024; no unverified A/D relabeling. Brachioles are reconstructed, exact number and poses artistic; no claim they are preserved complete in chosen photographed types.
clarifications.nucleocrinus: Replace provisional elongate-egg description BEFORE freeze with supported N.elegans subglobular body, distinguishing it from elongate Elaeacrinus/Placoblastus. Not a substituted genus/ID. Stem and brachioles reconstructed from supported skeletal attachments/general blastoid anatomy; their full extent, count and posture are not preserved in selected fossil photo and are artistic, explicitly uncertain. University photo accession ambiguity IP2041/1949 retained.
clarifications.placocystites: Normal P.forbesianus plating, oral spines and articulated aulacophore, not HC11 pathology; no contested calcichordate head/gill/tail assertions. Complete distal extent and shallow living thickness reconstructed; palette artistic.
